title: Ending Cardinal DriveSense Participation — Opt-Out and Termination Terms
content:
## Opting out

The customer may opt out of Cardinal DriveSense at any time. An opt-out is recorded on the enrollment with the date of the opt-out as its end date and the customer's opt-out as the reason, and the enrollment then shows opted out. An enrollment may be opted out from observing or from scored.

On opting out:

- a fixed earned discount is kept where the program keeps a fixed earned discount after opting out;
- a participation discount ends with the opt-out at the next renewal;
- a surcharge already fixed is kept until the next renewal;
- a pay-per-mile vehicle is re-rated at its full rated premium from the next renewal, with mileage charged through the opt-out date.

| Item held when the customer opts out | Treatment |
|---|---|
| Fixed earned discount | Kept, on a program that keeps a fixed earned discount after opting out |
| Participation discount | Ends with the opt-out at the next renewal |
| Fixed surcharge | Kept until the next renewal |
| Pay-per-mile rating | Full rated premium from the next renewal; mileage charged through the opt-out date |

## Ending of an enrollment

An enrollment ends when the vehicle leaves the policy, or when no data arrives for the program's no-data period of consecutive days during observation. A disconnected enrollment loses its participation discount.

| Cause | Enrollment states it ends from | Recorded reason |
|---|---|---|
| The vehicle leaves the policy | Observing or scored | Vehicle removed |
| No data for the program's no-data period of consecutive days, during observation | Observing | Device disconnected |

The ended enrollment shows terminated, with its end date and reason. Where the enrollment used a plug-in device, a device return is requested when the enrollment ends, whether by opt-out or by termination.

## Illustrations (hypothetical enrollments)

1. A vehicle in scored status with a fixed earned discount, on a program that keeps a fixed earned discount after opting out, opts out mid-term. The discount stays.
2. A vehicle in observing status receiving a participation discount opts out. The participation discount ends with the opt-out at the next renewal.
3. A Plug-In vehicle in scored status with a fixed surcharge opts out. The surcharge is kept until the next renewal, and a device return is requested.
4. A Cardinal DriveSense Miles Mobile vehicle opts out on the 18th of a month. Mileage is charged through the 18th, and from the next renewal the vehicle is rated at its full rated premium.
5. A vehicle in observing status sends no data for the whole of its program's no-data period of consecutive days. The enrollment ends as device disconnected and loses its participation discount.
